entries.content: Fixed. Root cause: `API.chunked_upload` in `tweepy/api.py` sent the media in 4 MB chunks, but the Twitter chunked-upload flow (and the recorded interactions, which match requests only by method+URI) expects 1 MiB chunks — for a 1.5 MB MP4 this meant only one APPEND request was sent instead of two, so the FINALIZE request matched a leftover empty 204 APPEND response, whose empty body parsed to `None` and caused `AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'items'` in `Media.parse`. Changing the chunk size to 1 MiB restores the correct INIT → APPEND(s) → FINALIZE sequence; all 60 tests in `tests/test_api.py` (including `testmediauploadmp4`, gif, and png) now pass.
